scripts.start: mkdir -p /app/.openclaw/agents/main/agent && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('/app/.openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json', JSON.stringify({'flock:manual': {'provider': 'flock', 'mode': 'token', 'token': process.env.FLOCK_API_KEY}}))" && openclaw onboard --non-interactive --accept-risk || true && openclaw gateway --allow-unconfigured
